title: Shakshuka
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet and saute chopped onion until soft.
2. Add garlic and diced bell pepper, cook 3 minutes.
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes, cumin, and paprika, simmer 10 minutes.
4. Make small wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
5. Cover and cook until egg whites are set.
6. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with bread.

title: Pancakes
instructions:
1. Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
2. In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter.
3. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
4. Heat a non-stick pan and pour batter into rounds.
5. Cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden.
6. Serve warm with maple syrup.

title: Masala Omelette
instructions:
1. Whisk eggs with chopped onion, tomato, green chili, and coriander leaves.
2. Add turmeric, salt, and a pinch of chili powder.
3. Heat oil in a pan and pour in the egg mixture.
4. Cook on medium heat until the base is set, then flip carefully.
5. Cook the other side until golden brown.
6. Serve hot with toast.

title: Congee
instructions:
1. Rinse rice and place in a pot with water and a pinch of salt.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into a thick porridge, about 45 minutes.
3. Stir in sliced ginger halfway through cooking.
4. Top with shredded chicken, chopped scallions, and a drizzle of sesame oil before serving.

title: Tamagoyaki
instructions:
1. Whisk eggs with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar until smooth.
2. Heat a rectangular tamagoyaki pan with a little oil.
3. Pour a thin layer of egg mixture and let it set slightly, then roll it to one side.
4. Add more egg mixture and repeat the rolling process until all egg is used.
5. Slice the rolled omelette and serve with soy sauce.

title: French Toast
instructions:
1. Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla extract in a shallow dish.
2. Dip bread slices into the mixture, coating both sides.
3. Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Cook the soaked bread slices until golden brown on both sides.
5. Serve warm topped with maple syrup and fresh berries.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions:
1. Toast bread slices until golden and crisp.
2. Mash ripe avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
3. Spread the mashed avocado generously over the toast.
4. Top with sliced cherry tomatoes and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
5. Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.

title: Ful Medames
instructions:
1. Place fava beans in a pot with water and simmer until soft, about 20 minutes.
2. Mash the beans lightly with a fork, leaving some texture.
3. Stir in minced garlic, lemon juice, cumin, and olive oil.
4. Season with salt to taste.
5. Transfer to a serving dish and top with chopped tomato and parsley.
6. Serve warm with flatbread.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions:
1. Layer Greek yogurt in a glass with a spoonful of honey.
2. Add a layer of granola followed by mixed fresh berries.
3. Repeat the layers until the glass is full.
4. Drizzle the top with extra honey.
5. Serve immediately or chill for later.

title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions:
1. Scramble eggs in a hot pan with salt and pepper.
2. Warm the tortillas on a dry skillet.
3. Fill each tortilla with scrambled eggs, black beans, shredded cheese, and diced tomato.
4. Add a spoonful of salsa.
5. Roll the tortilla tightly into a burrito.
6. Slice in half and serve warm.

title: Frittata
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180C.
2. Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
3. Saute chopped spinach and onion in an oven-safe skillet until wilted.
4. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables.
5. Sprinkle grated parmesan on top.
6. Transfer to the oven and bake until set and golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Overnight Oats
instructions:
1. Combine rolled oats, milk, and chia seeds in a jar.
2. Stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
4. In the morning, top with sliced banana and a handful of nuts.
5. Stir gently before eating.
6. Serve cold.

title: Poha
instructions:
1. Rinse flattened rice in a sieve and let it drain.
2. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they pop.
3. Add chopped onion, green chili, and curry leaves, saute until soft.
4. Stir in turmeric and the drained poha, mixing gently.
5. Cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
6. Garnish with lemon juice, coriander, and roasted peanuts.

title: Za'atar Manakish
instructions:
1. Prepare pizza dough and let it rest until doubled in size.
2. Divide the dough into small rounds and flatten each into a disc.
3. Mix za'atar spice blend with olive oil to form a paste.
4. Spread the za'atar paste evenly over each dough round.
5. Bake in a hot oven until the edges are golden, about 10 minutes.
6. Serve warm.

title: Scallion Pancakes
instructions:
1. Mix flour with hot water to form a dough and knead until smooth.
2. Rest the dough for 20 minutes, then roll it into a thin sheet.
3. Brush with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped scallions and salt.
4. Roll the dough into a log, coil it, then flatten into a disc.
5. Pan-fry in oil until crispy and golden on both sides.
6. Slice and serve.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions:
1. Tear romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
2. Toss with Caesar dressing until evenly coated.
3. Add croutons and shaved parmesan cheese.
4. Top with grilled chicken slices if desired.
5. Season with cracked black pepper.
6. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Caprese Sandwich
instructions:
1. Grill the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and olive oil until cooked through.
2. Slice ciabatta bread in half and lightly toast.
3. Layer the grilled chicken, fresh mozzarella, and sliced tomato on the bread.
4. Add fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
5. Close the sandwich and press slightly.
6. Slice in half and serve.

title: Falafel Wrap
instructions:
1. Blend soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and spices in a food processor until coarse.
2. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties.
3. Fry the falafel in hot oil until golden and crisp on all sides.
4. Warm the flatbread and spread hummus over it.
5. Fill with falafel, chopped lettuce, tomato, and tahini sauce.
6. Roll tightly and serve.

title: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions:
1. Season and cook diced chicken breast in a hot pan until fully cooked.
2. Place a tortilla in a skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese over half of it.
3. Add cooked chicken, sauteed peppers, and onion on top of the cheese.
4. Fold the tortilla over and cook until golden and the cheese melts.
5. Flip carefully and cook the other side.
6. Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
2. Add beaten eggs and scramble until just set, then push to the side.
3. Add diced carrot, peas, and chopped scallion, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
4. Add cold cooked rice, breaking up any clumps.
5. Stir in soy sauce and mix everything thoroughly.
6. Cook for another 3 minutes and serve hot.

title: California Roll
instructions:
1. Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, then let it cool.
2. Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo mat and spread a thin layer of rice over it.
3. Flip the nori so rice faces down.
4. Layer crab stick, avocado, and cucumber across the center.
5. Roll tightly using the bamboo mat.
6. Slice into pieces and serve with soy sauce.

title: Greek Salad
instructions:
1. Chop cucumber, tomato, red onion, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.
2. Combine the vegetables in a large bowl with kalamata olives.
3. Crumble feta cheese over the top.
4. Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice.
5. Sprinkle with dried oregano and salt.
6. Toss gently and serve chilled.

title: Chana Masala
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pan and saute chopped onion until golden.
2. Add ginger, garlic, and tomato, cooking until softened.
3. Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, and garam masala.
4. Add drained chickpeas and a splash of water, then simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Season with salt and garnish with fresh coriander.
6. Serve with rice or flatbread.

title: Peanut Salad
instructions:
1. Chop tomato, cucumber, and onion into small cubes and place in a bowl.
2. Whisk peanut butter with lemon juice, water, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
3. Pour the peanut dressing over the vegetables and toss well.
4. Sprinkle with chopped roasted peanuts.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander.
6. Serve chilled as a side dish.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions:
1. Slice fresh mozzarella and tomatoes into even rounds.
2. Arrange them alternately on a plate, overlapping slightly.
3. Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
4. Drizzle generously with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
5. Season with salt and cracked black pepper.
6. Serve immediately at room temperature.

title: BLT Sandwich
instructions:
1. Fry bacon strips in a pan until crisp, then set aside on paper towels.
2. Toast slices of bread until golden.
3. Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
4. Layer lettuce, sliced tomato, and crispy bacon between the bread.
5. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
6. Cut diagonally and serve.

title: Taco Salad
instructions:
1. Brown ground beef in a skillet with taco seasoning until fully cooked.
2. Layer shredded lettuce in a bowl as the base.
3. Top with the seasoned beef, black beans, corn, and diced tomato.
4. Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top.
5. Add a dollop of sour cream and crushed tortilla chips.
6. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot with sliced ginger.
2. Add shredded cooked chicken and simmer for 5 minutes.
3. Cook egg noodles separately according to package instructions, then drain.
4. Divide noodles among bowls and ladle the hot broth and chicken over them.
5. Top with chopped scallions and a drizzle of sesame oil.
6. Serve hot.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a pot and saute chopped onion, carrot, and garlic until soft.
2. Add red lentils, cumin, and turmeric, stirring to coat.
3. Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat and simmer until lentils are tender, about 25 minutes.
5. Blend until smooth with an immersion blender.
6. Season with salt and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Miso Soup
instructions:
1. Bring water to a gentle simmer in a pot, avoiding a hard boil.
2. Whisk in miso paste until fully dissolved.
3. Add cubed tofu and sliced scallions to the pot.
4. Simmer gently for 2-3 minutes without boiling.
5. Stir in a few dried wakame seaweed pieces.
6. Ladle into bowls and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions:
1. Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving some pasta water.
2. Fry diced pancetta in a pan until crispy.
3. Whisk eggs with grated parmesan and black pepper in a bowl.
4. Toss the hot pasta with pancetta, then remove from heat and quickly stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
5. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions:
1. Prepare pizza dough and let it rise until doubled.
2. Roll the dough out into a round base on a floured surface.
3. Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce over the dough.
4. Top with slices of fresh mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil.
5. Bake in a very hot oven until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.
6. Finish with fresh basil leaves before serving.

title: Grilled Lamb Chops
instructions:
1. Marinate lamb chops with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, and lemon juice for at least 30 minutes.
2. Preheat a grill to high heat.
3. Grill the lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
4. Let the chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
5. Season with salt and freshly cracked pepper.
6. Serve with a side of grilled vegetables.

title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken thighs in a mixture of yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, and shawarma spice blend for at least 1 hour.
2. Grill or pan-sear the chicken until fully cooked and slightly charred.
3. Slice the chicken into thin strips.
4. Warm flatbread and spread with garlic sauce.
5. Fill with chicken, pickles, and shredded lettuce.
6. Roll tightly and serve.

title: Bamia Okra Stew
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot and saute chopped onion and garlic until fragrant.
2. Add cubed beef and brown on all sides.
3. Stir in tomato paste and a splash of water, then simmer for 20 minutes until the beef is tender.
4. Add sliced okra and cook for another 15 minutes until softened.
5. Season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
6. Serve hot with rice.

title: Butter Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt, ginger, garlic, and spices for at least 30 minutes.
2. Grill or pan-sear the chicken until lightly charred and cooked through.
3. In a separate pan, simmer tomato puree with butter, cream, and garam masala.
4. Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander.
6. Serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Vegetable Biryani
instructions:
1. Soak basmati rice for 20 minutes, then parboil until 70% cooked and drain.
2. Saute onion, carrot, and peas with biryani spices in a pot until fragrant.
3. Layer the parboiled rice over the vegetables.
4. Drizzle with saffron-infused milk and cover tightly.
5. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes to let flavors steam through.
6. Fluff gently and serve with raita.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions:
1. Season ground beef with cumin, chili powder, and paprika, then cook in a skillet until browned.
2. Warm small corn tortillas on a dry pan or open flame.
3. Fill each tortilla with the seasoned beef.
4. Top with diced onion, chopped coriander, and a squeeze of lime.
5. Add a spoonful of salsa if desired.
6. Serve immediately.

title: Enchiladas
instructions:
1. Cook shredded chicken with onion and garlic until fragrant.
2. Fill corn tortillas with the chicken mixture and roll tightly.
3. Place the rolled tortillas seam-side down in a baking dish.
4. Pour red enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with shredded cheese.
5. Bake until the cheese is bubbling and golden.
6. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions:
1. Marinate diced chicken in soy sauce and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through, then remove.
3. Stir-fry dried chilies, garlic, and bell pepper in the same wok.
4. Return chicken to the wok along with peanuts and a mixed sauce of soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar.
5. Toss everything together until well coated.
6. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Beef and Broccoli
instructions:
1. Slice beef thinly against the grain and marinate with soy sauce and cornstarch.
2. Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the beef until browned, then set aside.
3. Stir-fry broccoli florets and garlic in the same wok until bright green.
4. Return beef to the wok with oyster sauce and a splash of water.
5. Toss until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
6. Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
instructions:
1. Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a small saucepan and simmer until slightly thickened.
2. Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Pan-sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp, then flip.
4. Pour the teriyaki sauce over the salmon and let it glaze while cooking through.
5. Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced scallion.
6. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Chicken Ramen
instructions:
1. Simmer chicken broth with sliced ginger and garlic for 20 minutes to develop flavor.
2. Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions and drain.
3. Slice cooked chicken breast and soft-boil eggs to soft-yolk consistency.
4. Divide noodles among bowls and ladle the hot broth over them.
5. Top with sliced chicken, halved eggs, scallions, and nori.
6. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Steak
instructions:
1. Pat the steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
2. Let it sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before grilling.
3. Preheat the grill to high heat and sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
4. Add a knob of butter and fresh thyme in the last minute.
5. Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
6. Serve with grilled vegetables.

title: BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Rub pork ribs generously with a dry spice mix of paprika, brown sugar, and garlic powder.
2. Wrap the ribs in foil and bake low and slow at 150C for 2 hours.
3. Unwrap and brush generously with barbecue sauce.
4. Grill the ribs for a few minutes on each side until caramelized.
5. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing between the bones.
6. Serve with extra barbecue sauce.

title: Baked Cod
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 200C.
2. Place cod fillets in a baking dish and drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
3. Scatter cherry tomatoes, olives, and capers around the fish.
4. Season with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
5. Bake until the fish flakes easily, about 15-18 minutes.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with crusty bread.

title: Lasagna
instructions:
1. Cook lasagna sheets according to package instructions.
2. Prepare a meat sauce by browning ground beef with onion, garlic, and tomato sauce, simmering until thick.
3. Make a bechamel sauce with butter, flour, and milk.
4. Layer lasagna sheets, meat sauce, bechamel, and mozzarella in a baking dish, repeating until ingredients are used.
5. Bake at 190C until bubbling and golden on top, about 30 minutes.

title: Kofta Kebabs
instructions:
1. Combine ground beef with grated onion, garlic, parsley, and a blend of spices in a bowl.
2. Mix well and shape the mixture around skewers into elongated kebabs.
3. Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
4. Grill the kofta, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
5. Serve with flatbread, tahini sauce, and a fresh salad.

title: Sharmout Stew
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a pot and saute chopped onion and garlic until golden.
2. Add dried spiced meat strips and stir to coat in the aromatics.
3. Pour in water and simmer until the meat softens, about 30 minutes.
4. Stir in tomato paste, cumin, and dried okra powder to thicken the stew.
5. Season with salt to taste.
6. Serve hot with kisra or rice.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 190C.
2. Cut the tops off bell peppers and remove the seeds.
3. Mix cooked rice with sauteed onion, ground beef, tomato, and herbs.
4. Stuff each pepper generously with the rice mixture.
5. Place the peppers upright in a baking dish and add a splash of water.
6. Cover and bake for 35-40 minutes until the peppers are tender.
7. Serve warm.

title: Hummus with Pita
instructions:
1. Drain canned chickpeas, reserving some liquid.
2. Blend chickpeas with tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and a splash of the reserved liquid until smooth.
3. Season with salt and cumin, adjusting consistency with more liquid as needed.
4. Spoon the hummus into a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
5. Sprinkle with paprika.
6. Serve with warm pita bread.

title: Guacamole with Chips
instructions:
1. Scoop ripe avocado flesh into a bowl and mash with a fork to desired consistency.
2. Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato, and coriander.
3. Add lime juice and a pinch of salt, mixing well.
4. Taste and adjust seasoning with more lime or salt as needed.
5. Transfer to a serving bowl.
6. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Spring Rolls
instructions:
1. Saute shredded cabbage, carrot, and mushroom with soy sauce until softened.
2. Let the filling cool slightly, then place a spoonful onto each spring roll wrapper.
3. Fold the wrapper over the filling, tucking in the sides, and roll tightly, sealing the edge with water.
4. Heat oil in a pan and fry the rolls until golden and crisp.
5. Drain on paper towels.
6. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

title: Bruschetta
instructions:
1. Slice a baguette into rounds and lightly toast until golden.
2. Dice fresh tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, minced garlic, and olive oil.
3. Season the tomato mixture with salt and pepper.
4. Spoon the mixture generously onto each toasted baguette slice.
5. Drizzle with a touch more olive oil.
6. Serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

title: Samosas
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, then mix with peas, cumin, and garam masala.
2. Cook the filling briefly in a pan to blend the flavors.
3. Cut samosa pastry sheets into strips and fold into cone shapes.
4. Fill each cone with the potato mixture and seal the edges with water.
5. Deep fry the samosas until golden and crisp.
6. Serve hot with mint chutney.

title: Cheddar Popcorn
instructions:
1. Pop popcorn kernels in a large pot with a small amount of oil until fully popped.
2. Transfer the popcorn to a large bowl.
3. Melt butter and toss it with the popcorn to coat evenly.
4. Sprinkle finely grated cheddar cheese powder and salt over the top.
5. Toss again until evenly distributed.
6. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Edamame
instructions:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
2. Add edamame pods and cook for 4-5 minutes until tender.
3. Drain the edamame and toss with sea salt and a pinch of chili flakes while still warm.
4. Transfer to a serving bowl.
5. Serve with an empty bowl for discarded pods.

title: Baklava
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 160C and brush a baking dish with melted butter.
2. Layer sheets of phyllo pastry in the dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
3. Sprinkle a mixture of chopped walnuts, pistachios, and cinnamon between layers.
4. Continue layering until all phyllo and nuts are used, then cut into diamond shapes.
5. Bake until golden and crisp, about 40 minutes.
6. Pour cooled honey syrup over the hot baklava before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions:
1. Cream softened butter with brown sugar and white sugar until fluffy.
2. Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
3. Stir in flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
4. Fold in chocolate chips.
5. Drop spoonfuls of dough onto a lined baking sheet.
6. Bake at 180C for 10-12 minutes until edges are golden.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves
instructions:
1. Rinse grape leaves and blanch briefly in hot water if fresh.
2. Mix cooked rice with chopped onion, herbs, and a splash of lemon juice for the filling.
3. Place a spoonful of filling on each grape leaf and roll tightly, tucking in the sides.
4. Arrange the rolls snugly in a pot and cover with water and olive oil.
5. Simmer gently for 40 minutes until tender.
6. Serve chilled or warm with lemon wedges.
